files.name: theme
files.prompt: Instrumental game music cue for a mobile gacha reward reveal in a steel factory. Heavy, dark, epic orchestral with industrial metal percussion (anvil hits, steel clangs), deep low strings, low brass, timpani. 100 BPM, D minor, no vocals. Structure: 0:00-0:04.8 two bars of tension build with timpani roll and low strings swelling into a crescendo; 0:04.8 one massive orchestral hit with a steel impact on the downbeat; 0:04.8-0:09.6 triumphant low brass plays a short memorable four-note motif; 0:09.6-0:15 resolve to D and let it ring out and fade. Weighty, punchy, cinematic.

files.name: rare-theme
files.prompt: Short instrumental sting for a legendary rare reward in a game: anomaly detected. Dark hybrid orchestral, deep sub bass, low choir-like brass pads, taiko and anvil hits, 100 BPM, D minor, no vocals. First three seconds: ominous accelerating heartbeat pulses and a low swelling drone, suspense rising. At three seconds: an enormous impact hit. Then five seconds of a grand, heroic and mysterious brass fanfare over sustained low strings, resolving and ringing out. Heavy and warm, no bright high-pitched sounds.

decision2: 2026-11-21 사용자 결정: 효과음이 "너무 라이트·날카로움" → 재생 때 음높이 낮춤·고음 깎기·저음 올리기·낮은 쿵(파일은 그대로). 덜컹 반복 대신 음악 모델 연주곡 한 곡: 후보 4개(ElevenLabs Music v2.5 2, Sonilo 2, 약 6.3크레딧) 측정 추천 ①을 게임에서 듣고 "①으로 확정". 앞서 시험한 Mirelo 고조음 후보 4개(5크레딧)는 쓰지 않는다.
decision3: 2026-11-21 사용자 결정: 특수 봉인 음악도 바꾼다. ElevenLabs Music v2.5 8초 후보 2개(약 2.3크레딧) 중 ②(두근거림 뒤 4.2초 솟음, 앞 1.2초 잘라 3.0초에 맞춤)를 게임에서 듣고 "소리는 좋아. 오케이". 함께 고친 점: 10연·레어의 0.7초 흔들림에서 출하 음악이 잘리던 것 → 낮게 차오르는 합성 울림.
